title: Multiscale vessel enhancement filtering

evidence.locator: Lines found from the eigenvalues of the Hessian of an image smoothed by a Gaussian at several widths, scale-normalised: a line curves strongly across itself and little along itself. Used here for the Homunculus's dark dust lanes (packages/bake/src/image-layers/filaments.ts).

publisher: Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention, LNCS 1496, 130
